## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] Work taken from others keeps its authorship and license, with a link to the source.
- [ ] If AI helped, the commits have an `Assisted-by:` line and I have reviewed every change myself.
- [ ] If this touches hardware (voltages, charging, thermal, frequencies, audio levels, display), values are within the vendor kernel's limits and the source is linked.
- [ ] No private data, firmware, Steam or game files.
